header_sentences: See Life after Death; and see Life.

contexts.text: Hence it has been given to hear and see the amazing things which are in the other life.
Its miserable state in the other life. Signified.
Immense fructification in the other life.
I have been for some years with Spirits in the other life.
Unless they know how Things are circumstanced in the other life.
Days scarcely intervene... before they are in the other life.
In the other life there is a communication of all the ideas of thought.
When it was given him to know that he was in the other life... he became anxious.
In the other life the thoughts of all can be manifestly perceived.
When man comes into the other life, he does not know that he is in the other life.
Whatever man has done... returns successively in the other life; nay, whatever he has thought. Explained.
In the other life the interiors for the first time manifest themselves...
Among the marvellous things in the other life are... AC 1637.
Concerning which things they think nothing in the other life.
Concerning spheres in the other life. General article.
In the other life he is continually perfected.
The things which disagree with eternal life... must be removed in the other life...
In the other life all are at first received as guests... AC 2119.
Had spoken much in public about the other life.
All Souls, as soon as they come into the other life, can understand the speech of all in the whole world...
These are the externals which are removed in the other life: man there is as he thinks and intends.
These (undergo temptations) in the other life...
In the other life (the evil and falsity) are presented to view as in clear light.
Such is the form of government in the other life...
As yet he did not know that he was in the other life.
For externals are removed in the other life.
He who passes into the other life loses nothing of the things which belong to man...
Such is the equilibrium in the other life that evil itself punishes itself.
Such delight and life are turned in the other life into...
How the ideas of thought are open in the other life.
The Souls who come into the other life successively put these things off...
The lot of these in the other life is miserable...
By the sight of the body, man cannot see anything in the other life...
Preface. Few will believe that anyone can see the things which come forth in the other life...
As very many say that they will believe if anyone would come to them from the other life...
Those who come into the other life from the Christian world are the worst of all...
For in the other life hearts speak. AC 4689:2.
All the states of man's life return successively in the other life...

This is evident from evil Spirits in the other other life... when the external bonds... are taken away, as is usual with all in the other life, they are more insane than those who are openly insane in the world.
By genuine visions are meant the visions... which come forth really in the other life...
For in the other life the interiors are open...
To receive the life of charity in the other life, when they have had none in the life of the body, is never possible...
If the Natural conquers, ho appears to be in tranquillity (here); but in the other life he comes into the unrest and torment of Hell.
Cannot apprehend that there are progressions [from place to place] in the other life.
What old age, and death, are, they do not know in the other life.
Fallacies in the other life alienate the ideas of thought... from the truth and good of faith.
This is why the deceitful and hypocrites, in the other life suffer more direful things...
These gentiles... in the other life receive the truths of faith better than those called Christians.
On the state of infants in the other life. General article.
When (such a man) passes into the other life, he comes from an obscure life into a clearer one...
They who come into the other life are all brought into a life like that which they had in the body...

To those who believe (that they have a spirit which will live after death), the other life is the all of their thought and affection... But to those who do not believe it, the world is the all of their thought and affection, and the other life is relatively nothing. The former are those who can be regenerated; and the latter are those who cannot.

I apperceived that they had not been long in the other life; for they did not know that they were there... It was granted to tell them that they were in the other life; but they soon forgot it... AC 3474.
(Good) gentiles are instructed in the other life... AC 2863:3.
The regenerate come into (the perception that all reformation is from the Lord) in the other life.
Everyone is gifted by the Lord in the other life with a lot according to the good of life...
All in the same good meet and are together in the other life; and also all in the same truth. Signified.
Man, while he lives in the body, is always, as to his soul, in some Society of Spirits in the other life. References, Signified.
In the other life there is no idea of space and time; but, in their stead, of state. In the other life all things do indeed appear as if in space, and succeed one another as if in time...
The delight with him (then) becomes happiness in the other life.
These externals, or simulations... are taken away in the other life...
Those who are... regenerated in the other life.
(These gentiles) receive interior truths in the other life.
(Good gentiles) have a good which is opened in the other life, when they are instructed there in the truths of faith.
Those who in the world have been in fatuous lumen are in the like in the other life...

Those who in the life of the body have received the things of the Lord... in the other life are gifted with intelligence and wisdom, and happiness ineffable... But those who have not received (them)... in the other life, after passing a short career there, are deprived of all intelligence...
Those who have been such in the life of the body, are such in the other life also.

If they do not, on account of worldly cares, apprehend these things in the life of the body, they do so in the other life, where worldly and corporeal things are removed; for they are then illustrated...
(Their character seen only in the other life.)
In the other life it is manifestly shown how much of evil from the Hereditary everyone has drawn to himself by actual life...
Such (experiences) are possible in the other life, but not in the world.
The Church... principally perishes... as to the states in the other life. Described... This inundation appears manifestly in the other life...

(Thus) if the natural man has not been prepared to receive the truths and goods of faith in the life of the body, he cannot receive them in the other life... For man has with him in the other life all the natural memory... but is not allowed to use it there...
The quality of the progression towards interior things... appears manifestly in the other life...
When he apperceives that he has more exquisite sensations... he observes that he is in the other life...
Those in the other life cannot see anything in this world through the eyes of any man... I did not see with the eyes of my body those with whom I spoke in the other life...
(Thus) everyone's life, and therefore affection, is manifestly open in the other life. Described.
To speak in the ear so that no one else should hear... is net proper in the other life... Such speech is heard more resonantly in the other life than open speech.
Everyone receives a reward in the other life according to his life in the world.

He who in the life of the body has despised others in comparison with himself, (does the same) in the other life: he who in the life of the body has hated the neighbour, (does the same) in the other life; and so on. Everyone retains in the other life that nature which he has put on in the life of the body...
Those who come into the other life from the Christian world (do not in the least adore the Divine Human of the Lord).
The pleasantness of peace (such have) in the other life.
In the world he has interior pleasantness; and in the other life heavenly joy.
Concupiscences... consume him in the life of the body, and torture him in the other life.
Those who have no conscience in the life of the body, cannot have any in the other life.
Man leaves the exteriors of the Natural when he dies; but the interiors of the Natural he carries with him into the other life; where they serve as a plane...

He (then sensates) the things which are in the other life; which do indeed for the most part appear like those in the world; but still are not like them; for they have what is alive in them... (because) they come forth and subsist from the Sun which is the Lord.
For, in the other life, there must be a concord and unanimity of all things...

For all the states which man has acquired for himself in the life of the body are retained in the other life, and are infilled; the states of good with the good are infilled with good... and the states of evil with the evil are infilled with evil... This is the meaning of the saying, that as man dies, so he remains.
This (ultimate) plane is nothing in the other life. Explained.
It is a law in the other life that no one must become worse...
Such is the order in the other life, that evil itself has its penalty with it...
The evil which men have imbued actually in the world, they bear with them into the other life.
The Lord permits the infernals in the other life to lead the good into temptation...

The man of the Church who comes into the other life, must be purified from such things as infest truths and goods. Explained... This rarely takes place while man lives in the body; but does so in the other life with those who are to be elevated into Heaven. Treated of.
But in the other life this (increase in truths from good) is immense; and this perpetually, to eternity.
Those who are (cunning) in the world, become worse in the other life...
The evils which lie hidden in the love of self do not manifest themselves in the world, but in the other life...
When the evil who infest the upright in the other life first arrive there, they have good Spirits and Angels adjoined to them...
By such degrees are the evil in the other life deprived of the understanding of truth and good. Treated of.
Few, when they come into the other life, enter at once into Heaven...
For the evil were then continually exciting the evils and falsities with those who came into the other life...
It is states of truth and good (or of falsity and evil), which are represented in the other life by heights and depths; in a word, by distances and places. References.
As soon as reflection is given them by the Lord, they know they are in the other life...
On the first ingress of Souls into the other life.
That there are indefinite varieties in the other life. Explained.
They who come into the other life at first suppose that they are still in the body...
On the marvellous things which come forth in the other life.
On the translation of men into the other life.
In the other life, when they are remitted into a state like that of the life of their body... they do not at all know that they are in the other life.

That in the other life they are prepared, so that they can be kept in a state of persuasion. Spirits sometimes think it is wonderful that in the other life they do not at once come into a state of faith in the Lord. Explained.
On amendment in the other life.
He was answered that... he is now in the other life, where he has whatever is requisite for the use of the other life...
I told the Spirits that there is quite a different kingdom in the other life...
All who come into the other life are by degrees remitted into the life which they had in the world...
On naturalists in the other life.
(They think), I can easily believe these things if I see them in the other life... But this is never the case. Those who have no faith in the world, have no faith in the other life. Described.

The inmost or spiritual man is perfected in the other life; but only in so far as it can have agreement in the external or natural man; but (the latter) cannot he perfected in the other life; but remains such as it has been acquired in the life of the body.
None can acknowledge and confess the Lord in the other life but those who have (done so) in the world.
